console.reload_config.description: Reload Chest Peek's config.json without restarting the game.
config.use_hotkey_preview.name: Use hotkey preview
config.use_hotkey_preview.tooltip: When enabled, chest contents are shown only while holding the preview key. When disabled, hovering over a chest shows the preview automatically.
config.preview_key.name: Preview key
config.preview_key.tooltip: The keybind used to trigger chest preview when hotkey preview is enabled.
config.enable_pause_preview.name: Enable pause preview
config.enable_pause_preview.tooltip: Only works when hotkey preview is enabled. In single-player, holding the preview key pauses the game and lets you move the mouse to inspect chests. Multiplayer will not pause.
